name: ListRepositoryTree

parameters.description_en: The enterprise identifier, also known as the organization ID, is a string that can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】.

parameters.description_en: The file path within the code repository. Specifies the folder whose contents you want to retrieve. By default, the entire structure of the repository's file tree is retrieved.
parameters.description_zh: 代码仓库内的文件路径，获取该路径下的文件目录，默认获取代码库文件树的全部结构

parameters.name: path

parameters.description_en: The branch name, tag name, or commit ID. Defaults to the repository's default branch.

parameters.name: ref_name

parameters.description_en:
The search strategy:  
DIRECT: Lists only the contents of the current folder.  
RECURSIVE: Recursively retrieves all files under the current path.  
FLATTEN: Flattens the structure (if the path is a folder, recursively traverses it until subdirectories contain files or multiple folders).
parameters.description_zh:
查找策略
DIRECT：仅展示当前目录下的内容
RECURSIVE：递归查找当前路径下的所有文件
FLATTEN：扁平化展示（如果是目录，递归查找，直到子目录包含文件或多个目录为止）
